website.result: No public clinical pipeline page; corporate site describes fertility clinic services and the INVOcell device, not a drug pipeline.

INVOcell.modality: Class II medical device (intravaginal culture system)

fertility_clinics.description: Operates INVO Centers and one IVF clinic in the United States offering IVC and IVF services.

excluded_partner_owned.note: INVO holds a minority equity stake in NTI; assets belong to NAYA, not INVO.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Adjacent medtech / fertility-services company. Core business is the FDA-cleared INVOcell intravaginal culture device and operation of fertility clinics (INVO Centers and an IVF clinic). No proprietary drug or device clinical trials in P1/P2/P3 sponsored by INVO Fertility are active. The 10-K mentions NAYA Therapeutics oncology assets (NY-303, NY-500, NY-338), but these are partner-owned via a minority equity stake and are excluded under the partner-owned rule.
